name: 实现 DeploymentService (part 2)
description:
实现 DeploymentService 服务方法: executeDeployment, pushLiveLogs
  - executeDeployment: (deploymentId: UUID) -> void pre=部署记录存在且 status = pending；环境仍处于 online 状态
  - pushLiveLogs: (deploymentId: UUID, wsConnection: WebSocket) -> void pre=部署记录存在；WebSocket 连接已建立并完成 HTTP 升级握手
